title: Pure Cubic
summary: Cubic cards only, with generic Links and staples. Cubic is a swarm-and-climb deck built on Vijam the Cubic Seed: it can't be destroyed in battle, and after battling it sits in your Spell & Trap Zone and puts a Cubic Counter on that monster (it can't attack and its effects are negated). The Cubic Kings and Beasts summon themselves from the hand by sending Cubic monsters you control to the GY. They hit hard, then send themselves away to bring back Vijams and search the next Cubic. Buster Gundil and Indiora Doom Volt need three Cubics and rebuild the board when the opponent removes them. Duza the Meteor Cubic Vessel mills a Cubic card when summoned. Crimson Nova comes out by revealing three Cubic cards, and three Crimson Novas fuse into Crimson Nova Trinity through Unification of the Cubic Lords. The 2020 cards lead: Cubic Dharma cycles Cubics and recovers one, Cubic Ascension pulls Vijams from the Deck when they attack, and Cubic Causality spreads Cubic Counters.
main: Vijam the Cubic Seed
Can't be destroyed in battle; becomes a Spell and locks the monster it fought.
Duza the Meteor Cubic Vessel
Normal Summon starter: mills a Cubic card.
Crimson Nova the Dark Cubic Lord
Summoned by revealing three Cubic cards; attacks twice.
Geira Guile the Cubic King
Sends one Cubic to summon itself and burn 800; revives Vijams and searches Vulcan Dragni.
Dark Garnex the Cubic Beast
Sends one Cubic to summon itself; revives Vijams and searches Blade Garoodia.
Vulcan Dragni the Cubic King
Sends two Cubics to summon itself and burn 800; revives Vijams and searches Indiora.
Blade Garoodia the Cubic Beast
Sends two Cubics to summon itself; revives Vijams and searches Buster Gundil.
Indiora Doom Volt the Cubic Emperor
Sends three Cubics to summon itself; rebuilds and searches when they remove it.
Buster Gundil the Cubic Behemoth
Sends three Cubics to summon itself; attacks three times; rebuilds when removed.
Cubic Dharma
Newest: no battle damage from Cubics; cycles a Cubic and recovers one.
Cubic Karma
Mills Vijams for ATK; halves their LP; banishes from the GY to search a Cubic monster.
Cubic Wave
Doubles a Cubic's ATK and halves theirs; spreads Cubic Counters from the GY.
Cubic Ascension
Newest Trap: summons Vijam from the Deck into their attack; banishes from the GY for more Vijams.
Cubic Causality
Newest Trap: spreads Cubic Counters; burns when a Cubic destroys a locked monster.
Unification of the Cubic Lords
Fusion Summons Crimson Nova Trinity; banishes from the GY to summon a small Cubic.
extra: Crimson Nova Trinity the Dark Cubic Lord
Fusion of three Crimson Novas: halves their LP when it attacks.
